rustcc class with constructor.description: rustcc class with a constructor and one virtual method, using the v1.13.5 method-modifier keywords (`constructor fn` / `virtual fn`). These desugar to #[constructor] / #[cpp_virtual].

rustcc class with inheritance.description: rustcc class inheriting from a base, overriding a base virtual with `override fn` (verified at compile time: errors if no base virtual of that name exists). Desugars to #[cpp_virtual] + #[rustc_cxx_override].

rustcc class method-modifier method.description: A single class-body method using a v1.13.5 modifier keyword (constructor / virtual / override). `constructor` is contextual; `virtual` / `override` are reserved keywords.

swift_value! macro.description: Swift value type with auto-derived Drop/Clone via metadata-driven witnesses.

M26 build helper for build.rs.description: Skeleton build.rs invoking the M26 Build helper for header → bindings → static archive.

include! generated bindings.description: Pull in generated bindings from cxx_importer's M26 pipeline.

rustc_cxx_throws extern fn (v1.13.0 nati.description: v1.13.0 native-invoke extern decl for a throwing C++ fn. The fork rustc lowers calls to LLVM invoke + landingpad; CxxException carries the runtime helper's CxxRawError after From conversion.

rustc_cxx_throws extern fn with typed ca.description: v1.13.0 native-invoke extern decl with typed catches. The Itanium + MSVC type-info lists must be in the same order so `From<CxxRawError>` indexing matches on both targets. Normally auto-emitted by cxx_importer; this snippet is for hand-written bindings.
